correctness.rationale: For every s≤n/2 a small reachable set is an outgoing-closed set with rooted spanning arborescence. Summing Cayley tree probabilities yields o(1) uniformly; edge reversal gives large predecessor sets. Intersect >n/2 reach and predecessor sets to get exact all-pairs closure. Mixed zero-degree factorial moments tend to independent Poisson(λ) moments, including overlap configurations. An explicit q-round EF strategy proves stabilization and first-order convergence. The layer automorphism classification follows from intrinsic relation types. Finite independent checker corroborates, not replaces, proof.
